market.read: The S&P 500 fund closed under its 200-day average on almost three times its usual volume, and the fear gauge is at 30. Most new buys fail in a market like this, so today's bar is high and the list is short.

items.name: Apple
items.headline: Holding its 50-day average while the market breaks
why: Still in an uptrend: the price is above its 50-day average (341.81), and that is above its 200-day (303.24).
It fell 1.9% on a day the S&P 500 fund fell 3.6%. A stock that refuses to fall with the market is where buyers are.
It is 5.1% under its 52-week high, so there is room back to that high before sellers are likely to show up.
items.risks: The market is falling hard. If the S&P 500 fund keeps sliding, this goes with it, and a close under 332 says the uptrend has broken.
items.evidence: No rule fired a long signal on it today. This is a read of the trend and of how it held up, not a rule with a record.

passed.why: RSI 15 looks like a bargain, but it is under every average and fell 14% on heavy volume. Oversold in a breakdown is not a floor. Wait for a day that closes up.
Oversold at RSI 24.9, and it closed under its 200-day average. On this list the Oversold rule has not beaten an ordinary day, so there is no edge in buying it yet.
Down 52.6% from its high and still making new lows. Nothing here says the selling is over.
